```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

```{r data, include = FALSE}
data("rest_inspec")

rest_inspec = 
  rest_inspec |>
  rename(borough = boro) |>
  filter(
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    borough != "Missing",
    !is.na(score)
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(borough = str_to_title(borough))
```
